sources.quote: Home - iHUB Security Verification Please verify you're human to continue We are the leading pan-African creative and innovation ecosystem enabler. Our vision is to accelerate the application of social capital and technology for economic prosperity across Africa. Our programs Learn more iHUB is a globally recognized innovation center that’s part of the Co-Creation Hub, dedicated to accelerating the application of social capital and technology to enhance economic prosperity in Kenya and across the continent.
